name: walkcameracontrols-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `walkCameraControls` flag (tier:simple — present in BOTH modes per CLAUDE.md, so the ladder proves the flag itself controls the UI via a direct setFeatureFlag override rather than a Simple/Pro switch): the 'Walk settings' FOV/eye-height sliders in the Appearance popover only render in firstPerson camera mode, are absent in orbit, present by default in both Simple and Pro while in walk mode, a real drag-free slider change round-trips to the store, and a direct setFeatureFlag('walkCameraControls', false) hides the section (restoring it brings it back).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: walkCameraControls should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: assert-walk-settings-absent-in-orbit
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.popover.appearance')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Walk settings')) throw new Error('Walk settings section visible while in orbit mode (should only show in firstPerson)'); })()

steps.name: assert-walk-settings-present-simple
steps.failMessage: Walk settings section missing in walk mode, Simple mode (walkCameraControls is simple-tier, should show in both modes)

steps.name: assert-fov-updated
steps.failMessage: walkFov did not update to 85 after setWalkFov(85)

steps.name: assert-fov-slider-reflects-value
steps.eval: (function(){ const sliders = [...document.querySelectorAll('.popover.appearance input[type=range]')]; const fovSlider = sliders.find(s => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Field of view (degrees)'); if (!fovSlider) throw new Error('FOV slider input not found'); if (Number(fovSlider.value) !== 85) throw new Error('FOV slider value is ' + fovSlider.value + ', expected 85'); })()

steps.name: assert-eye-height-updated
steps.failMessage: walkEyeHeight did not update to 1.7 after setWalkEyeHeight(1.7)

steps.name: assert-walk-settings-present-pro
steps.failMessage: Walk settings section missing in walk mode, Pro mode

steps.name: assert-walk-settings-absent-with-override
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.popover.appearance')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Walk settings')) throw new Error('Walk settings section still visible after setFeatureFlag(walkCameraControls, false) — flag override did not hide it'); })()

steps.name: assert-walk-settings-present-restored
steps.failMessage: Walk settings section did not reappear after restoring the flag to true
